<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">前言</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">上一章我们看完了交换架构<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设备内部<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">搬运工<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的调度中枢；本章补上另一半：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发架构<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。报文进入设备后如何被解析、查表、切片、重组？为什么路由器要经历五代架构演进、交换机要走完四步？<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两大芯片流派各自的算盘是什么？本章按<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">什么是转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基本原理<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基本原则<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">质量属性<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构类型<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">芯片流派<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">路由器与交换机演进<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">未来方向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的主线展开。适合已阅读过前面以太网、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TCP/IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与交换架构章节的读者。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">一、什么是转发：五种转发类型</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发是数据通信网络中最基础的动作，但<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">并不只有一种形态。按报文依据的地址与机制不同，可以分为二层、三层、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MPLS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SR <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与组播五种类型。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.1 转发的定义</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left horizontal-splitline normal"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发是数据通信网络中数据包从源节点到目的节点的传递过程。每个数据包前有一个报文头，用以指明其发往何地址。设备依据该地址将数据包送至预期目的地，这一过程就是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="405.002939632546" height="340.07884514435693" id="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335285-856587616.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　数据报文转发过程</span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.2 二层转发：查 MAC 地址表</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">二层转发是基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">地址进行数据包转发的过程。在网络七层模型中，二层指的是数据链路层，二层转发主要用于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">同一局域网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下主机之间的通信：转发设备根据数据包的目的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">地址查找<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">地址表，确定出接口并转发。以太网帧依次由前导码（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Preamble<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">7 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）、帧起始定界符（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SFD<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）、目的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DMAC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）、源<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SMAC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Type/Length<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Payload<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">46<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">～<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1500 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）和帧校验序列（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FCS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）组成。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.3 三层转发：查路由表</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">三层转发发生在网络七层模型的第三层，即网络层，是路由器的基本功能：路由器根据<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IPv4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">报文中的网络层地址查询路由表，选择合适的路由，将报文处理后发送到下一台设备，主要用于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">跨网段<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的通信。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IPv4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">报文头包含<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Version<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IHL<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Service Type<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Total Length<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Time to Live<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Protocol<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Header Checksum<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Identifier<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Flags<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Fragment Offset<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，以及各<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 32 bit <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的源地址与目的地址，必要时还有<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Options and Padding <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">字段。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.4 MPLS 转发：基于标签</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MPLS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发是一种利用标签来指导数据报文高速转发的技术，工作原理包括<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">标签分配、标签交换、标签剥离<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">三个步骤。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MPLS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">头部为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 32 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">比特，由标签（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">20 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CoS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">S<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> TTL<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">8 bit<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）组成，位于二层头部与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">头部之间<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">所谓<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"MPLS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发是基于标签的转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.5 SR 转发：源路由</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SR <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发是源路由技术：入口节点将转发路径信息封装进数据包头，中间节点依此转发，出口删除<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SR <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">头后继续转发；它会在原始数据包中插入段列表来规划转发路径。工作原理分为五步：路径分段、段标识分配、路径编码、逐段转发、目的节点处理。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.6 组播转发：一对多</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">组播是一种通过网络进行一对多通信的技术，组播转发会根据需要把同一个报文复制到多个出口。其基本原理围绕三点展开：组播地址、组播组、转发机制。</span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">二、转发的基本原理：报文在设备内的六步旅程</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在第九章硬件架构与第十一章交换架构的基础上，本章给出了报文穿越一台设备的完整路径。以路由器为例，一次转发要经过六个步骤：</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">1.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据光<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">电信号上行时，由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PIC 卡<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转为数据帧并校验合法性，再发送至转发处理器；</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">2.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发处理器<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP/ASIC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）接收报文后，解析二层帧头并按配置检查；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">3.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TM<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Traffic Manager<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，流量管理）从转发处理器获取报文，存入<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Buffer <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">并完成拥塞管理等处理；</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">4.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">报文送交换网前经<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> TM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">切片分割，交换网板基于信元交换，下行时重组流量；</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">5.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据经下行<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> TM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">处理至下行转发处理器，后者查封装表获取目的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">出口信息并修改报文，经出口处理后发送给<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">卡；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">6.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下行<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">卡计算帧检验、封装数据帧，再转为光<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">电信号发送至线路。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="502.0036745406824" height="339.86582677165353" id="2" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335290-361337708.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　报文在网络设备内的转发处理过程</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分工上看：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">卡负责接口出入的报文收发与帧处理；转发处理器（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP/ASIC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）承担报文解析、上行<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下行流分类、查表转发、下行封装；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">负责上行<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下行<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> QoS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">处理（拥塞管理、队列调度、多播复制<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">缓存管理）以及切片与组包处理<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">上行切为微信元送入交换网，下行再从微信元组包还原。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">三、转发的基本原则</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在具体架构之前，转发设计有三条被广泛遵循的原则，它们共同决定了数据通信系统的形态。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">端到端原则<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：将功能划分为端到端的两端，即源系统和目的系统<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">源系统负责产生和发送数据，目的系统负责接收和处理数据。这种设计有利于简化系统架构，提高系统的灵活性和可维护性。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">宽进严出原则<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：数据包转发过程中，发送方应严格遵循协议规范，确保发送数据的质量和准确性；接收方应具备处理各种可能的数据格式和变异的能力，以增强系统的容错能力和兼容性。一<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">宽<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">一<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">严<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，提高的是网络的健壮性和可靠性。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转控分离原则<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：将系统的控制平面与转发平面进行物理或逻辑上的分离<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">控制平面负责决策、管理和配置等控制逻辑，转发平面负责数据的实际传输或处理。转控分离可以提高系统的可扩展性、可维护性和安全性，并提升网络的可靠性。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">四、转发系统的五个关键质量属性</span></h2>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">属性</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">内涵</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可靠性和可用性</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发面可靠性指高效、准确、稳定处理数据包的能力，以及故障时提供有效容错和恢复机制的能力；可用性指系统正常运行的时间比例，通常用两次故障间的时间长度或故障恢复速度表示</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发性能</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设备每秒可以转发的数据包数量，用于评估处理能力和性能瓶颈；影响因素包括硬件处理能力、存储容量、总线带宽以及转发算法等</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">灵活性与可编程性</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">灵活性指修改转发系统中包处理行为的能力；可编程能力让用户根据自身需求定制网络功能，不再受限于硬件厂商的固定功能</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可扩展性</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">面对用户需求增长或数据量增加时，平滑提升处理能力或扩充存储容量的能力</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">安全性</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在为合法用户提供服务的同时，阻止非授权用户使用企图或抵御拒绝服务攻击的能力</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">五、集中式与分布式转发架构</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">把第四节的五个属性作为标尺，转发架构的第一道分水岭就是：查表集中在一处，还是分散到每块线卡。</span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5.1 集中式转发架构</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left horizontal-splitline normal"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">集中式转发架构是指所有线卡收到的数据流量都送到同一个处理器集中进行查表处理。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">该架构由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Route Processor<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CPU<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Memory <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">组成处理核心，各<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Line Card <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DMA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">经共享<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Bus <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">连接。实现简单、成本低，但所有流量挤一个处理器，天然存在性能瓶颈。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="525.003779527559" height="339.961469816273" id="3" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335302-187189781.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 3<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　集中式转发架构</span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5.2 分布式转发架构</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式转发架构是指每个线卡都独立查表转发流量，线卡间通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Switch Fabric <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">互联。每块<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Line Card <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">内置<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Packet Processor<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Memory <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CPU Card <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">只负责管理面任务。转发性能高、扩展性好，适配大规模数据处理，是现代设备的主体形态。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="548.0039895013123" height="198.833280839895" id="4" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335273-1323512896.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　分布式转发架构</span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">六、转发处理器的两大技术流派</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发处理器的技术路线之争，本质上是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">用硬件换性能<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">用指令换灵活<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两种取向的分歧。业界由此分化出<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两大流派，两者在可编程能力、专用模块比例与适用场景上差异显著。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6.1 ASIC 流派：硬化逻辑换性能</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流派源于传统芯片逻辑设计，初期为无灵活性的硬件转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，可编程能力基于数字逻辑设计技术（如芯片综合、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FPGA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">等），核心是类似<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FPGA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的可编程转发加速与互联单元，与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流派的指令集<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">执行模型有本质差异。该流派成本低但灵活性差，演进方向是用可编程逻辑单元替代硬件逻辑单元以提升业务灵活性。其内部又分两档：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">硬件逻辑转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">通过硬化逻辑实现，转发行为固定，不支持新特性；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可配置逻辑转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">借助可配置专用转发单元处理，修改配置能有限变更转发行为，支持简单新功能。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6.2 NP 流派：指令编程换灵活</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流派源于传统<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RISC CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构设计，可编程能力继承自<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RISC CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构技术，通过可编程机器指令执行模型实现。优点是依托指令实现多种功能、灵活性高；缺点是芯片实现成本高，演进方向是提升指令效率与卸载指令以提高报文处理效率。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">针对数据分组处理采用优化体系结构、专用指令集和硬件单元，满足高速数据分组线速处理需求，能快速实现新标准、服务与应用。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">又有两种执行模型：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RTC（并行处理式）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：基于传统多<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Core <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构，多<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Core <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可执行任意长度转发处理程序，能兼顾高性能简单业务与低性能复杂业务；</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PipeLine（流水线式）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：各处理器设计为特殊包处理任务，按流水线方式运作，前一处理器处理完数据后传递给后一处理器。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="492.00356955380573" height="339.83748031496066" id="5" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335304-961083074.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">RTC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（并行处理式）和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PipeLine<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（流水线式）</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6.3 两大流派对比</span></h3>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="96">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">对比项</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="96">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC·<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">硬件逻辑</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="96">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC·<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可配置逻辑</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="96">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC·<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可编程逻辑</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="96">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP·Pipeline</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="96">

</td>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">一句话概括：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">侧重高性能低成本，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">侧重灵活性，二者的可编程能力与适用场景差异显著。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">七、路由器转发技术：五代演进</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">路由器的转发技术可以划分为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">集中式转发、准分布式转发、分布式转发、ASIC 转发、NP 转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">五个阶段。每一步演进都在回答同一个问题：上一代的瓶颈是什么，如何绕开它。</span></span></span></p>

<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">

</td>

</table>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">第 1 代·集中式转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：接口卡与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">经内部总线连接，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">负责路由收集、转发处理、设备管理等所有事务；网络接口接收报文后经内部总线传给<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，处理完再从另一接口传出。所有报文处理集中于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，易出现<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">总线瓶颈。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="262.0018897637795" height="339.63212598425196" id="6" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335308-222967003.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 6<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　第<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">代路由器集中式转发架构</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">第 2 代·准分布式转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：利用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Cache <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术将常用路由信息保存在业务接口卡上，多数报文直接用业务板<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Cache <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">路由表转发，仅<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Cache <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">中未找到出接口的报文才送<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">处理，减少对总线和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的需求，解决了<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">总线瓶颈<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">因为只在接口卡完成<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">部分<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">报文处理，故称准分布式。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">第 3 代·分布式转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：主控板负责设备管理、路由收集与计算，并将生成的转发表下发至各业务板；各接口板依据保存的路由转发表独立完成路由转发。同时总线技术大幅发展，接口板间数据转发无需依赖主控板，实现并行高速处理，路由器处理性能大幅提升。该架构将路由表查找过程完全下放至各接口板，是典型分布式架构。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">第 4 代·ASIC 分布式转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：针对转发流程设计专门的大规模集成电路，以硬件方式实现数据包的路由转发处理，极大提高转发性能。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">通常采用流水线处理结构，将任务均匀分配到流水线各部件，交换网采用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CrossBar <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">或共享内存方式解决内部交换问题。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="262.002" height="339.632" id="7" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335306-749605491.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 7<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　第<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">代路由器<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式转发架构</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">第 5 代·NP 分布式转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：关键<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务流程处理采用可编程、专为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络设计的网络处理器技术。网络处理器通常由多个微处理器和硬件协处理器构成：微处理器并行处理、通过软件控制处理流程，复杂标准操作由硬件协处理器处理，实现业务灵活性与高性能的结合。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="262.002" height="339.632" id="8" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335263-2099685801.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 8<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　第<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">代路由器<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式转发架构</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">八、交换机转发技术：四步演进</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换机基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的转发技术经历了多种架构，主要有<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU + ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">芯片的集中式转发架构、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CPU + ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">芯片的分布式转发架构，以及<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU + ENP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">芯片的分布式转发架构等几种，对应四步演进：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">阶段</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年代</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">动因</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1989 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年诞生初期</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">集中式转发（固定接口）</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络规模小、数据量少、变化小，所有流量经主控板集中转发</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1998—2002 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">集中式转发（模块化接口）</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">解决扩展性问题，网络接口改为可插拔模块，报文在主控板完成控制集中转发</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2003 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年后</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式转发</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">突破集中式转发性能瓶颈：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式部署于每个接口单元，整机性能为所有接口板处理性能之和</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">近年</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ENP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式转发</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">兼顾性能与灵活性：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ENP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">融合<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">之长</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>

</table>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="473.003" height="339.828" id="9" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261020100335285-240374253.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 9<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　分布式转发架构（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ENP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">芯片）</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">其中 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ENP 芯片<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">值得一提：它基于成熟应用十余年的路由器<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">芯片，融合<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">芯片工作原理，内置硬件加速组件、片内集成<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SmartMemory <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和高速查找算法，既保留传统<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的成本、功耗、性能优势，又具备灵活可编程能力。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">九、转发架构的未来演进</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">面向未来，转发架构将沿五个方向演进。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">高性能硬件加速<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：转发架构将更多运用高性能硬件加速数据包处理，提高转发性能与吞吐量，以可编程处理器为单位构建全可编程流水线架构，拆分集中查找引擎和资源为每级流水线的局部引擎与资源，实现报文处理流程及每级流水线处理的全可编程。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">集成在网计算<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：未来转发芯片将更多集成在网计算能力，在数据面集成计算能力可降低通信时延、提高计算效率。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能化和自动化<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：通过分析学习网络流量模式与行为特征，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">AI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ML <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可预测应对潜在网络问题，自动优化网络性能与资源分配。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">安全可靠和绿色节能<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：内置安全功能防范网络攻击与数据泄露，采用高可用设计提高系统可靠性，并侧重低功耗设计、运用先进节能技术，同时降低能耗与运营成本。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">本章总结</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发基础<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：转发是数据包从源节点到目的节点的传递过程，设备依据报文头中的地址信息将其送至预期目的地；核心类型有二层（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">地址表，局域网内）、三层（路由表，跨网段）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MPLS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（标签分配<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交换<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">剥离）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SR<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（源路由，路径分段<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">段标识分配<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">路径编码<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">逐段转发<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">目的节点处理）、组播（一对多复制）五种。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基本原理与原则<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：报文经<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">卡转换校验、转发处理器解析查表、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">TM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">拥塞管理与切片、交换网信元交换与重组、下行封装、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">卡发帧六步完成转发；三大原则为端到端、宽进严出、转控分离。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">质量属性<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：可靠性和可用性、转发性能、灵活性与可编程性、可扩展性、安全性五个维度。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">架构与流派<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：集中式架构所有流量集中查表，实现简单但有瓶颈；分布式架构每线卡独立查表、经<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Switch Fabric <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">互联。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流派低成本高灵活性差，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流派基于指令、灵活性高成本高，分<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Pipeline <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> RTC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两种执行模型。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">专属设备演进<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：路由器历经五代<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">集中式（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">瓶颈）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">→ <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">准分布式（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Cache <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">缓解）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">→ <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式（接口板独立转发）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">→ ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式（硬件提速）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">→ NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式（灵活与高性能兼得）；交换机四步走<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">固定接口集中式<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">模块化接口集中式<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> → ENP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分布式。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">未来方向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：高性能硬件加速（全可编程流水线）、集成在网计算、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">AI/ML <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能化自动化、安全可靠与绿色节能。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">结语</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">从一块<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">包办所有查表，到每块线卡各自为战，再到<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两条流派在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">性能还是灵活<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的天平上反复校准，转发架构三十多年的演进史其实是一部<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">瓶颈迁移史<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：总线成了瓶颈就下放查表，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CPU <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转不动就硬化成<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ASIC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，特性迭代跟不上就用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">找回灵活，最后<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ENP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">干脆把两者捏到一颗芯片里。看懂了这条主线，再看全可编程流水线与在网计算这些新词，不过是同一场演进的下一章。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</div>

</div>
